name: remote-jobs
description: Remote Jobs by Country finds remote jobs a person can actually be hired for from where they live. Ask "remote software jobs I can get from Vietnam", "remote support jobs open to the Philippines" or "crypto jobs that hire in Brazil".

interface.longDescription:
Remote Jobs by Country finds remote jobs a person can actually be hired for from where they live. Ask "remote software jobs I can get from Vietnam", "remote support jobs open to the Philippines" or "crypto jobs that hire in Brazil".

Many remote posts only hire in one country or one time zone. For every job it reads the post's location, its stated country or region limit, its excluded countries, its time zone window and its work permit lines, and gives a verdict for your country: open, when the post includes your country or hires from anywhere, or unclear, when the post says remote but names no limit. Each verdict comes with a one-line reason that quotes the post. Jobs that rule your country out are never shown.

The index is rebuilt every day from public company job boards on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor, Pinpoint, Breezy HR, Rippling, BambooHR, Workday and Gem, and from remote job feeds that allow reuse with a link back (Remote OK, Himalayas, Jobicy, Arbeitnow, Python.org Jobs and Startup Jobs). Closed and expired jobs drop out on the next refresh.

You can narrow by role family (software, data, design, product, marketing, sales, support, ops, finance, HR, assistant), job type (full-time, part-time, contract, internship), niche (crypto and web3, AI, startups, nonprofits, academia, government) and keywords.

Every job links to its application page and to a page on tools.openkrill.app. The verdict is a reading of the post's own words, not a promise of being hired: an unclear job needs a check with the employer. It stores nothing about you.
capabilities: Finds remote jobs a person can be hired for from a named country
Gives each job a verdict for the country, open or unclear, with a reason quoting the post
Never shows a job whose post rules the country out by place or time zone
Narrows by role family, job type, niche (crypto, AI, startup, nonprofit, academia, government) and keywords
Links every job to its application page and its source
Refreshed every day from public company job boards and remote job feeds
defaultPrompt: Find remote software jobs I can get from Vietnam.
Which remote customer support jobs are open to the Philippines?
Show me crypto jobs that hire from Brazil.

positive.description: country VN and up to 10 jobs, each open or unclear with a reason quoting the post and an applyUrl; no job limited to the US or another country without Vietnam. Check against: The daily index behind https://tools.openkrill.app/remote-jobs?country=VN&family=software
positive.prompt: Find remote software jobs I can get from Vietnam.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_remote_jobs with country "Vietnam" and family "software".

positive.description: Only open jobs, each with a reason that names the Philippines, a region that holds it, or worldwide hiring. Check against: https://tools.openkrill.app/remote-jobs?country=PH&family=support
positive.prompt: Which remote customer support jobs are open to the Philippines? Only ones that clearly include my country.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_remote_jobs with country "Philippines", family "support" and only_open true.

positive.description: Jobs tagged crypto, open or unclear for Brazil, each with a reason and an applyUrl. Check against: https://tools.openkrill.app/remote-jobs?country=BR&niche=crypto
positive.prompt: Show me crypto jobs that hire from Brazil.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_remote_jobs with country "Brazil" and niche "crypto".

positive.description: At most 5 part-time marketing jobs, open or unclear for India. Check against: https://tools.openkrill.app/remote-jobs?country=IN&family=marketing&type=part_time
positive.prompt: Part-time remote marketing jobs I can do from India, please, up to 5.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_remote_jobs with country "India", family "marketing", type "part_time" and limit 5.

positive.description: Jobs whose text mentions React, open or unclear for Singapore, each with a reason and an applyUrl. Check against: https://tools.openkrill.app/remote-jobs?country=SG&keywords=react
positive.prompt: I'm a React developer in Singapore. Any remote React jobs I can apply to?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_remote_jobs with country "Singapore", family "software" and keywords "react".

negative.description: The verdict depends on the country; the tool must not guess it. Expected: Does not call the tool yet. Asks which country the user will work from, then calls find_remote_jobs with it.
The plugin only reads public job posts and cannot apply. Expected: Does not submit anything. Gives the applyUrl so the user applies.
negative.prompt: Apply to the first remote job for me.

negative.description: find_remote_jobs indexes remote jobs only and answers by country, not by company office. Expected: Does not call find_remote_jobs: the user asks about one company's on-site jobs, not remote jobs for a country.
negative.prompt: What jobs is Stripe hiring for in its office in Dublin?

publication.release_notes: First release. find_remote_jobs returns remote jobs that are open or unclear for a country, each with a verdict, a reason quoting the post and the application link, from a daily index of public company job boards and remote job feeds.
